target: Figure 3 transient field snapshots at 24.8, 26.8, 29.8, 31.8 fs
control: Figure 3 runs only the PT geometry; the no-hole control remains in the parent Figure 2 project.
scope: EMW FDTD transient Plot, sine/cosine quadrature optical intensity; no steady-state extractor or SDevice
original_paper_optics: 3D periodic unit cell; E parallel to paper y
surrogate: three translational slots, X periodic, depth CPML; TM in EMW 2D means E along out-of-plane coordinate
coordinate_mapping: optical X=paper x, Y=-paper z, out-of-plane optical Z=paper y

optical_inputs.InGaAs: linear lambda and Ga-fraction interpolation of installed InGaAs CRI tables at xGa=0.47
optical_inputs.InAlAs: installed constant-index model interpolated at xAl=0.48; lossless
optical_inputs.Silicon_Oxide: linear wavelength interpolation of installed CRI tables
optical_inputs.grading: homogeneous optical effective layer, mean n,k of InGaAs and InAlAs across 50 nm, replacing the parent composition staircases only in this optical surrogate
optical_inputs.free_carrier_optics: not included; no author doping/optical constants table available

geometry_assumptions: same estimated contact/charge/grade thicknesses and assumed BOX, truncated handle, top SU8, hole SU8 filling as parent model_basis.json
wavelength_basis: continuation of the Figure 2 resonance wavelength; Figure 3 does not restate wavelength

source_signal.envelope_basis: same NRise=8 as existing Figure 2; paper does not provide rise/phase details

normalization: store physical field; report both framewise |E|^2/max_frame and common |E|^2/max_all_frames; no amplitude fitting or time shift
snapshot_method: independent, identical FDTD runs from t=0; fixed integer time-step endpoint and FinalPlot=Yes; no time shifting or changing models between frames
monitor_note: monitor decimation affects diagnostic sampling only, not the FDTD update or endpoint field
Yee_time_staggering: Final E field is inferred from native monitor Time/TickStep relation at duration-dt/2; baseline offset 0.005 fs, time-step check offset 0.0025 fs. Plots use the requested times rounded to 0.1 fs, without time translation.
